sections.h2: What Is AI SEO for Gulf Brands?

paragraphs.html: AI SEO, also called generative engine optimisation (GEO), is the work of making your brand easy for AI assistants to find, understand and cite. Traditional SEO aims for a ranking in a list of links. AI SEO aims for a mention inside the answer itself. For Gulf businesses, that answer may be in English or Arabic, and it may name only two or three companies. Our AI search optimisation for Gulf brands focuses on being one of them, and our AI SEO services GCC clients use are built around that single goal.

AI SEO does not replace SEO. Google says the same best practices apply to its AI features, so a well-built, trusted website remains the foundation. Read Google's guidance on AI features. We build on that foundation through our SEO company for GCC businesses service.

sections.h2: How Do AI Engines Choose Which Brands to Cite?
sections.intro: No AI engine publishes a full formula, but testing across many prompts shows clear patterns. AI answers tend to cite brands that are:

items.html: Clearly described: the same name, services, locations and facts appear on your website and across the web.
Quotable: pages contain short, factual answers, figures and definitions that are easy to lift into a reply.
Mentioned by others: directories, reviews, news sites and industry lists talk about you.
Accessible: AI crawlers are allowed to read your pages, and your content is not hidden behind scripts.
Current: pages show dates, recent results and up-to-date prices.

outro.text: This is why AI search visibility GCC brands earn depends as much on your reputation across the web as on your own website.

sections.intro: Every plan combines five workstreams, shaped to your markets and budget.

items.title: Prompt Tracking
items.text: We build a list of 30 to 60 prompts your buyers actually ask, such as "best logistics company in Jeddah" or "which Dubai agency builds Shopify stores". We test them each month in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Microsoft Copilot and Google AI Overviews, and log whether your brand is mentioned, cited or linked, and which competitors appear instead.

items.title: Entity Consistency
items.text: AI engines connect facts about your company into one "entity". We align your name, address, services, founders and key facts across your website, Google Business Profile, LinkedIn, Wikidata where eligible, and major directories, so engines are not confused by mixed details.

items.title: Quotable Facts
items.text: We add short answer blocks, FAQs, comparison tables, prices and dated results to your key pages, with schema markup so engines can read them correctly.

items.title: Third-Party Mentions
items.text: We help you earn mentions on the sites AI engines trust: industry directories, chambers of commerce, review platforms, regional news and expert round-ups.

items.title: AI Crawler Access
items.text: We check your robots.txt and server settings so crawlers such as OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot and Googlebot can read your public pages. Several assistants, including Microsoft Copilot, draw on Bing's index, so we also verify your site in Bing Webmaster Tools.

sections.h2: Who Needs AI SEO in the Gulf?
sections.intro: AI SEO helps most when buyers compare options before they call. In the Gulf, that includes:

items.html: Professional services: law firms, consultancies, accountants and recruiters, where buyers ask AI to shortlist firms.
Real estate and construction: developers, brokers and contractors, where trust and track record matter.
Healthcare: clinics and hospitals, where patients ask which provider to visit.
Ecommerce and retail: brands that want to appear in product and "best of" answers.
B2B and industrial suppliers: firms whose buyers ask AI for vendor lists and specifications.
Companies entering the region: brands from India, Europe and elsewhere that need AI engines to know they now serve Gulf customers.

paragraphs.text: To start, we need access to your website, Google Search Console, Google Business Profile and analytics, plus a list of your main services, locations and competitors. If you have press coverage, awards or case studies, share them too: they often become the facts AI engines quote.
